rootCauses.detail: Metadata-only consumer checkouts invoked readTypeSurface without the commit-bound receipt produced from the complete authenticated corpus.
Fault instrumentation required eight spaces while the generated runtime uses tabs for stub declarations.

scope: Authenticate the retained type-surface evidence corpus once, distribute its exact commit-bound receipt to the reviewed corpus and all sixteen metadata-only Nix consumers, and retain their bounded sparse source closures. Repair recursive JVM fault instrumentation against the actual generated tab indentation and prove all 36 stub anchors. Refresh exactly 96 live source citations across three paths without changing any support cell, stage, observation, package API or frozen #1220 model.

edits.current:
type-surface-authentication:
    name: Type-surface evidence authentication
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - name: Free hosted runner disk for the evidence checkout
        run: |
          df -h /
          sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet /usr/local/lib/android /opt/ghc /usr/local/.ghcup /opt/hostedtoolcache/CodeQL
          df -h /
      - name: Check out the exact revision
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: ${{ env.LEAN_BRIDGE_CONSUMER_SPARSE_CHECKOUT }}
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: npm
      - name: Install dependencies without lifecycle scripts
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Authenticate the exact type-surface corpus once
        run: |
          node scripts/create-core-type-surface-evidence-receipt.mjs \
            --receipt build/consumer-type-surface/receipt.json \
            --manifest build/consumer-type-surface/materialization.json \
            --commit "${{ github.sha }}"
      - name: Preserve the exact type-surface receipt
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: consumer-type-surface-${{ github.sha }}
          path: build/consumer-type-surface
          if-no-files-found: error
          overwrite: true
          retention-days: 7
